fee_notes: Learning Center franchise fee is $40,000 (uniform for new franchisees); Studio Center franchise fee is $30,000. In fiscal year ended December 31, 2023, actual Learning Center fees collected ranged from $30,000 to $35,000, and Studio Center fees collected were $20,000. A 10% discount is offered to qualified U.S. military veterans and active-duty personnel (repayable if interest is transferred within first 2 years). Under a Development Agreement, discounted fees apply: $40,000 for the 1st franchise, $35,000 for 2nd–5th franchises, and $30,000 for 6th and additional franchises. Fee is due at signing, paid in one lump sum, fully earned when paid, and non-refundable.
raw_excerpt:
The initial franchise fee for a Learning Center franchise is $40,000 and is due when you sign the Franchise Agreement. The initial franchise fee is fully earned when paid, must be paid in one lump-sum amount, and is non-refundable. The initial franchise fee is uniform for new franchisees. In our last fiscal year ended December 31, 2023, the initial franchise fees we collected for Learning Center franchises ranged from $30,000 to $35,000.

The initial franchise fee for a Studio Center franchise is $30,000 and is due when you sign the Franchise Agreement and Studio Center Rider. The initial franchise fee is fully earned when paid, must be paid in one lump-sum amount, and is non-refundable. The initial franchise fee is uniform for new franchisees. In our last fiscal year ended December 31, 2023, the initial franchise fees we collected for Learning Center franchises were $20,000.
